nights.title: Yandel
nights.name: Yandel
nights.extract: Llandel Veguilla Malavé, best known by his stage name Yandel, is a Puerto Rican singer who is a member of the reggaeton duo Wisin & Yandel. He released his first solo album, Quien Contra Mí, in 2003. His second solo studio album, De Líder a Leyenda, was released in 2013 and was certified Gold (Latin) by the RIAA in 2014.

en.who: Llandel Veguilla Malavé, best known as Yandel, is a Puerto Rican singer and a member of the reggaeton duo Wisin & Yandel. His second solo studio album, De Líder a Leyenda, was released in 2013.
facts: He released his first solo album, Quien Contra Mí, in 2003.
His second solo studio album, De Líder a Leyenda, was released in 2013 and was certified Gold (Latin) by the RIAA in 2014.

de.who: Llandel Veguilla Malavé, bekannt als Yandel, ist ein puertoricanischer Sänger und Mitglied des Reggaeton-Duos Wisin & Yandel. Sein zweites Soloalbum De Líder a Leyenda erschien 2013.
facts: Sein erstes Soloalbum Quien Contra Mí erschien 2003.
Sein zweites Soloalbum De Líder a Leyenda erschien 2013 und wurde 2014 von der RIAA in den USA (Latin) mit Gold ausgezeichnet.

tr.who: Llandel Veguilla Malavé, Yandel adıyla tanınan bir Porto Rikolu şarkıcıdır ve reggaeton ikilisi Wisin & Yandel'in üyesidir. İkinci solo stüdyo albümü De Líder a Leyenda 2013'te çıktı.

nights.title: Colin James
nights.name: Colin James
nights.extract: Colin James is a Canadian blues rock singer and songwriter. James has been very successful in Canada, having attained seven Gold-certified albums in Canada during his career, including four Platinum albums and two Double Platinum albums.

en.kicker: canadian blues rock singer and songwriter
en.who: Colin James is a Canadian blues rock singer and songwriter. He has been very successful in Canada, with seven Gold-certified albums during his career.
facts: James has attained seven Gold-certified albums in Canada during his career.
He has four Platinum albums and two Double Platinum albums.

de.who: Colin James ist ein kanadischer Blues-Rock-Sänger und Songwriter. Er war in Kanada sehr erfolgreich, mit sieben Gold-Alben während seiner Karriere.
facts: James erreichte in seiner Karriere sieben in Kanada mit Gold ausgezeichnete Alben.
Er hat vier Platin-Alben und zwei Doppel-Platin-Alben.

tr.kicker: kanadalı blues rock şarkıcı ve söz yazarı
tr.who: Colin James, Kanadalı bir blues rock şarkıcısı ve söz yazarıdır. Kanada'da çok başarılı oldu; kariyeri boyunca yedi Gold sertifikalı albümü var.
facts: Kariyeri boyunca Kanada'da yedi Gold sertifikalı albüme ulaştı.
Dört Platinum ve iki Double Platinum albümü var.
